entries.prompt: Edit the supplied original Wildbond Hushpup/Hushmane sheet. Preserve both creatures' exact anatomy, fur, face markings, poses and placement. entries.prompt: Using the supplied original Wildbond Saillet/Draftscale/Stormfrill sheet as identity and style reference, generate ONLY a revised final STORMFRILL full-body cutout on a genuinely transparent background. Do not include the first two stages. Preserve Stormfrill's friendly amber eyes, dark cheek stripe, grey-blue skin, three pale tail bands, lizard snout and four existing reptile legs. Change the adult sail from one tall upright dorsal fin into a dramatic broad pair of wing-like FIN MEMBRANES that unfurl laterally from the existing sail's spine ribs, sweeping backwards and upwards like storm-catching sails. Frill fins are part of its dorsal/neck membrane anatomy, NOT new arms or arbitrary dragon wings. One near sail arches broadly over its back and the far sail makes a clearly separated outline above/behind the head. Lizard body long and low, four legs plainly visible, stable confident stance, same creature all the way. Major silhouette transformation: wider majestic storm canopy, not just a taller version of the adolescent sail. Thin restrained lightning seams within fins. Three-quarter side view facing LEFT. Entire tail/sails/feet in frame with generous padding. Crisp dark ink contour, soft painted texture, same subdued palette and upper-left light as sheet. No backdrop, no ground, no shadow or halo, no text.
entries.reason: A second sail is visible, but broad lateral construction and alpha cleanup still need acceptance; retained as an alternative, not selected.
